mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below its 6-month moving average) indicates supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month average indicates sustained consumer spending strength, supporting corporate revenues and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above their respective 3-month moving averages indicates a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS and UNRATE meet their respective conditions, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
